-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2d-E1 (addendum V2d, ruling R-W5): a
-- second command elaborator for the freeze command's syntax kind, attached with

-- never runs the command, so it builds and perturbs nothing.

open Lean Elab Command in
@[command_elab WhatwgTest.Audit.Freeze.freezeCommand]
def plantedSecondFreezeElaborator : CommandElab := fun _ => pure ()
